text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock A and Stock E to lock in gains; satisfying as that felt, I should avoid letting the pleasure of realized profits alone determine when to exit.","My account value fell in Periods 4 and 5 despite selling at gains, reminding me that profitable trades do not guarantee the overall portfolio is doing well; I should monitor total risk and diversification.","Frequent account checking and trading can encourage reactive decisions. I should use clear, forward-looking reasons for each trade rather than focusing too heavily on average cost or recent price moves."]}
